verses.sloka: स गत्वा सागरम् राजा गंगया अनुगतस् तदा ।प्रविवेश तलम् भूमेः यत्र ते भस्मसात् कृताः ॥१-४४-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā sāgaram rājā gaṁgayā anugatas tadā ।praviveśa talam bhūmeḥ yatra te bhasmasāt kṛtāḥ ॥1-44-1॥

translations.english: Thereupon that king followed by Ganga reached the ocean and entered the lower regions of the earth where the sons of Sagara were found reduced to ashes.
translations.hindi: —88: — रि 0 द्विचत्वारिंशः सगः कालधमं गते राम सगरे प्रकृतीजनाः । राजानं रोचयामासुरंशमन्तं सुधार्मिकम्‌

verses.sloka: भस्मनि अथ आप्लुते राम गंगाइआः सलिलेन वै ।सर्व लोक प्रभुः ब्रह्मा राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४४-२॥
verses.transliteration: bhasmani atha āplute rāma gaṁgāiāḥ salilena vai ।sarva loka prabhuḥ brahmā rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-44-2॥

translations.english: After the ashes were inundated by the waters of Ganga, Brahma, lord of the world, appeared before king Bhagiratha and said:
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! महाराज अंशुमान बड़े प्रतापी राजा हुए । उनके पुत्र जगतप्रसिद्ध महाराज दिलीप हुए

verses.sloka: तारिता नरशार्दूल दिवम् याताः च देववत् ।षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि सगरस्य महात्मनः ॥१-४४-३॥
verses.transliteration: tāritā naraśārdūla divam yātāḥ ca devavat ।ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi sagarasya mahātmanaḥ ॥1-44-3॥

translations.english: "O Tiger among men sixty thousand sons of illustrious Sagara having been liberated, had gone towards heaven like devatas.
translations.hindi: महाराज अंशुमान ने अपने पुत्र दिलीप को राजसिंहासन पर बिठा कर स्वयं हिमालय के शिखर पर जा कठोर तप किया

verses.sloka: सागरस्य जलम् लोके यावत् स्थास्यति पार्थिव ।सगरस्य आत्मजाः सर्वे दिवि स्थास्यन्ति देववत् ॥१-४४-४॥
verses.transliteration: sāgarasya jalam loke yāvat sthāsyati pārthiva ।sagarasya ātmajāḥ sarve divi sthāsyanti devavat ॥1-44-4॥

translations.english: O King as long as the waters in the ocean exist in this world, shall the sons of Sagara, live in heavens like gods.
translations.hindi: अन्त में बत्तीस हजार वर्ष तप करने के बाद वे महायरास्वी महाराज अंशुमान भी स्वर्गवासी हुए (किन्तु गङ्गा नहीं आई )

verses.sloka: इयम् च दुहिता ज्येष्ठा तव गंगा भविष्यति ।त्वत् कृतेन च नाम्ना अथ लोके स्थास्यति विश्रुता ॥१-४४-५॥
verses.transliteration: iyam ca duhitā jyeṣṭhā tava gaṁgā bhaviṣyati ।tvat kṛtena ca nāmnā atha loke sthāsyati viśrutā ॥1-44-5॥

translations.english: This Ganga will become your eldest daughter and from now on she will be wellknown in this world (as Bhagirathi) after your name.
translations.hindi: महाराजा दिलीप अपने पितामहाँ के बध का वृत्तान्त जान कर मर्माहत हुए, किन्तु ( श्रीगङ्गा जी के लाने का ) कोई उपाय चे भी निश्चय न कर सके

verses.sloka: गंगा त्रिपथगा नाम दिव्या भागीरथी इति च ।त्रीन् पथो भावयन्ति इति तस्मत् त्रिपथगा स्मृता ॥१-४४-६॥
verses.transliteration: gaṁgā tripathagā nāma divyā bhāgīrathī iti ca ।trīn patho bhāvayanti iti tasmat tripathagā smṛtā ॥1-44-6॥

translations.english: O King divine Ganga will be called Tripathaga as well as Bhagirathi. Since she flows in the three worlds (heaven, earth and the lower world: Patala), she will be known as Tripathaga.
translations.hindi: ठ महाराज (भी) पितरों के उद्धार के लिए चिन्तत थे कि, इतने में नरशादूल दिलीप बीमार हुए और मर गए

verses.sloka: पितामहानाम् सर्वेषाम् त्वम् अत्र मनुजाधिप ।कुरुष्व सलिलम् राजन् प्रतिज्ञाम् अपवर्जय ॥१-४४-७॥
verses.transliteration: pitāmahānām sarveṣām tvam atra manujādhipa ।kuruṣva salilam rājan pratijñām apavarjaya ॥1-44-7॥

translations.english: O Lord of men O King you may offer the waters of Ganga here to all your ancestors and thereby fulfil your vow.
translations.hindi: धर्मात्मा सुप्रसिद्ध महाराज दिलीप नित्य ऐसा सोचा करते कि, इतने में उनके परमधार्भिक भगीरथ नाम का पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ

verses.sloka: पूर्वकेण हि ते राजन् तेन अतियशसा तदा ।धर्मिणाम् प्रवरेण अथ न एष प्राप्तो मनोरथः ॥१-४४-८॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvakeṇa hi te rājan tena atiyaśasā tadā ।dharmiṇām pravareṇa atha na eṣa prāpto manorathaḥ ॥1-44-8॥

translations.english: O King by the highly renowned ancestors of yours, the foremost among righteous ones (even Sagara) this desire has not been fulfilled.
translations.hindi: महाराज दिलीप ने बहुत यज्ञ किए और तीस हजार वर्ष राज्य भी किया

verses.sloka: तथैव अंशुमता वत्स लोके अप्रतिम तेजसा ।गंगाम् प्रार्थयता नेतुम् प्रतिज्ञा न अपवर्जिता ॥१-४४-९॥
verses.transliteration: tathaiva aṁśumatā vatsa loke apratima tejasā ।gaṁgām prārthayatā netum pratijñā na apavarjitā ॥1-44-9॥

translations.english: O Child similarly though Anshuman possessed unparalleled prowess in this world his prayer to Ganga, his vow could not be fulfilled.

verses.sloka: राजर्षिणा गुणवता महर्षि सम तेजसा ।मत् तुल्य तपसा चैव क्षत्र धर्म स्थितेन च ॥१-४४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: rājarṣiṇā guṇavatā maharṣi sama tejasā ।mat tulya tapasā caiva kṣatra dharma sthitena ca ॥1-44-10॥

translations.english: O Sinless one (Bhagiratha) O Distinguished one on the part of Dilipa brilliant your father who had the virtuous of a rajarshi, who was equal to a maharshi in splendour, and to me in austerities and abiding to the duties of a kshatriya it was even not possible to bring Ganga through prayer.

verses.sloka: दिलीपेन महाभाग तव पित्रा अतितेजसा ।पुनर् न शकिता नेतुम् गंगाम् प्रार्थयत अनघ ॥१-४४-११॥
verses.transliteration: dilīpena mahābhāga tava pitrā atitejasā ।punar na śakitā netum gaṁgām prārthayata anagha ॥1-44-11॥

translations.english: O Sinless one (Bhagiratha) O Distinguished one on the part of Dilipa brilliant your father who had the virtuous of a rajarshi, who was equal to a maharshi in splendour, and to me in austerities and abiding to the duties of a kshatriya it was even not possible to bring Ganga through prayer.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! महाराज भगीरथ परमधार्मिक राजपि थे और निस्सन्तान होने से वे सन्तान होने की इच्छा करते थे

verses.sloka: सा त्वया समतिक्रान्ता प्रतिज्ञा पुरुषर्षभ ।प्राप्तो असि परमम् लोके यशः परम संमतम् ॥१-४४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvayā samatikrāntā pratijñā puruṣarṣabha ।prāpto asi paramam loke yaśaḥ parama saṁmatam ॥1-44-12॥

translations.english: O Best among men you have fulfilled that vow. You have achieved supreme renown and reverence in this world.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! जव उनके पुत्र न हुआ, तब राज्यभार अपने मन्त्रियों को सौंप, वे स्त्रयं गोकणे नामक तीथे पर जा, गङ्गावतरण के लिये बहुत दिनों तक तपस्या करते रहे

verses.sloka: तत् च गंगा अवतरणम् त्वया कृतम् अरिन्दम ।अनेन च भवान् प्राप्तो धर्मस्य आयतनम् महत् ॥१-४४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tat ca gaṁgā avataraṇam tvayā kṛtam arindama ।anena ca bhavān prāpto dharmasya āyatanam mahat ॥1-44-13॥

translations.english: O Destroyer of enemies by bringing about the descent of Ganga, you have secured a great abode in dharma.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--गोकर्ण एक तीर्थ है जो गोग्रा से ३० मील उत्तरी किनारे पर है । सीतापुर प्रान्त में गोला गोकरननाथ नामक एक स्थान है । ] ८ : ऊर्ध्वबाहुः पञ्चतपा मासाहारो जितेन्द्रियः । तस्य वर्षसहस्राणि घोरे तपसि तिष्ठतः

verses.sloka: प्लावयस्व त्वम् आत्मानम् नरोत्तम सदा उचिते ।सलिले पुरुषश्रेष्ठ शुचिः पुण्यफलो भव ॥१-४४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: plāvayasva tvam ātmānam narottama sadā ucite ।salile puruṣaśreṣṭha śuciḥ puṇyaphalo bhava ॥1-44-14॥

translations.english: O Best among men O Tiger among men take a dip in the eternally sacred waters, purify yourself and acquire holiness.
translations.hindi: हे महावाहो एक हजार वर्ष बीतने पर लोकों के स्वामी और ग्रसु ब्रह्मा जा भगारथ पर सुप्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: पितामहानाम् सर्वेषाम् कुरुष्व सलिलक्रियाम् ।स्वस्ति ते अस्तु गमिष्यामि स्वम् लोकम् गम्यताम् नृप ॥१-४४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: pitāmahānām sarveṣām kuruṣva salilakriyām ।svasti te astu gamiṣyāmi svam lokam gamyatām nṛpa ॥1-44-15॥

translations.english: O King perform the rites of all your forefathers with the waters (of Ganga), farewell. I shall return to my world (now). Go back, O King" (said Grandsire)
translations.hindi: ओर देवताओं को साथ ले, वे तपस्या में लगे हुए, महात्मा भगीरथ के पास जा कर, बोले

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा देवेशः सर्वलोक पितामहः ।यथा आगतम् तथा अगच्छत् देव लोकम् महायशाः ॥१-४४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktvā deveśaḥ sarvaloka pitāmahaḥ ।yathā āgatam tathā agacchat deva lokam mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-44-16॥

translations.english: "The Grandsire of all the worlds, highly renowned lord of the gods, having Said this, returned to heaven the way he had come.
translations.hindi: हे महाराज भगीरथ ! तुमने बड़ी कठिन तपस्या की, अतः हम तुम पर प्रसन्न हैं । हे सुत्रत ! वर माँगो

verses.sloka: भगीरथः तु राजर्षिः कृत्वा सलिलम् उत्तमम् ।यथाक्रमम् यथान्यायम् सागराणाम् महायशाः ॥१-४४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: bhagīrathaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā salilam uttamam ।yathākramam yathānyāyam sāgarāṇām mahāyaśāḥ ॥1-44-17॥

translations.english: The illustrious rajarshi Bhagiratha, performed the rites of offering the sacred water of Ganga, in accordance with proper order and tradition for the sons of Sagara. Purified with the ablutions entered his own city." O Best of the Raghus his desire thus fulfilled he continued to rule the kingdom thereafter".
translations.hindi: तमुवाच महातेजाः सवलोकपितामहम्‌ । भगीरथो महाभागः कृताञ्ञलिरुपस्थितः ।। १७] यह सुन, महातेजस्वी भगीरथ ने हाथ जोड़ कर, ब्रह्मा जी से कहा

verses.sloka: कृतोदकः शुची राजा स्वपुरम् प्रविवेश ह ।समृद्धार्थो नरश्रेष्ठ स्वराज्यम् प्रशशास ह ॥१-४४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtodakaḥ śucī rājā svapuram praviveśa ha ।samṛddhārtho naraśreṣṭha svarājyam praśaśāsa ha ॥1-44-18॥

translations.english: The illustrious rajarshi Bhagiratha, performed the rites of offering the sacred water of Ganga, in accordance with proper order and tradition for the sons of Sagara. Purified with the ablutions entered his own city." O Best of the Raghus his desire thus fulfilled he continued to rule the kingdom thereafter".
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌! यदि आप मुझ पर प्रसन्न हैं और मेरे तप का फल देना चाहते हैं, तो यह वर दीजिए कि सगर के पुत्रों को मेरे द्वारा गङ्गाजल प्राप्त हो

verses.sloka: प्रमुमोद च लोकः तम् नृपम् आसाद्य राघव ।नष्टशोकः समृद्धार्थो बभूव विगतज्वरः ॥१-४४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: pramumoda ca lokaḥ tam nṛpam āsādya rāghava ।naṣṭaśokaḥ samṛddhārtho babhūva vigatajvaraḥ ॥1-44-19॥

translations.english: "O Best of the Raghus the world rejoiced having Bhagiratha as king. With his purpose achieved, he was freed from all mental afflictions and sorrows and thereafter lived happily.

verses.sloka: एष ते राम गंगाया विस्तरो अभिहितो मया ।स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रम् ते संध्या कालो अतिवर्तते ॥१-४४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa te rāma gaṁgāyā vistaro abhihito mayā ।svasti prāpnuhi bhadram te saṁdhyā kālo ativartate ॥1-44-20॥

translations.english: O Rama I have related you the story of Ganga in detail. Evening time is passing by (and we shall perform the ablutions) farewell.

verses.sloka: धन्यम् यशस्यम् आयुष्यम् पुत्र्यम् स्वर्ग्यम् अथ अपि च ।यः श्रावयति विप्रेषु क्षत्रियेषु इतेरेषु च ॥१-४४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: dhanyam yaśasyam āyuṣyam putryam svargyam atha api ca ।yaḥ śrāvayati vipreṣu kṣatriyeṣu itereṣu ca ॥1-44-21॥

translations.english: He will be blessed with fame, longevity, progeny and (after death) heaven brahmins One who recites this story of Ganga to the kshatriyas and others, the gods and his forefathers would be pleased with him.
translations.hindi: महाराज भगीरथ के ये वाक्य सुन, सर्वलोकपितामह, ब्रह्मा यह मधुर एवं शुभ वाणी बोले

verses.sloka: इदम् आKयनम् आयुश्यम् गंगा अवतरणम् शुभम् ॥१-४४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: idam āKyanam āyuśyam gaṁgā avataraṇam śubham ॥1-44-22॥

translations.english: O Son of the Kakusthas whosoever listens to this auspicious story relating to the descent of Ganga with concentration, all his desires will be achieved, his sins will be destroyed and his longevity and fame will increase". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: हे महारथी भगीरथ ! तेरा मनोरथ है तो बड़ा, किन्तु वह वू होगा अर्थात्‌ तुमे पुत्र की प्राप्ति होगी । हे इच्चाकुकुलवर्धन ! तेरा मङ्गल हो

verses.sloka: यः श्रुणोति च काकुत्स्थ सर्वान् कामान् अवाप्नुयात् ।सर्वे पापाः प्रणश्यन्ति आयुः कीर्तिः च वर्धते ॥१-४४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śruṇoti ca kākutstha sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt ।sarve pāpāḥ praṇaśyanti āyuḥ kīrtiḥ ca vardhate ॥1-44-23॥

translations.hindi: हिमालय की ज्येष्ठा पुत्री यह गङ्गा जी जब ( बड़े वेग से ) पृथ्वी पर गिरेंगी, तब इनका वेग प्रथ्वी न सम्हाल सकेगी । च उनके वेग को सम्दाल सकने की सामथ्यै शिव अ [मथ्यं शिव को छोड़ और किसी में नहीं है
